title: profile-search-projector
blurb: A CDC projector treats allocated IDs as commit order, skips invisible changes, and advances its checkpoint separately from projection writes.
brief:
A profile service projects an append-only change journal into a search table. A slow transaction owns an earlier change ID while a later ID becomes visible first; the projector advances past the gap and never returns. A crash can also leave projection data ahead of its checkpoint.

Inspect the SQLite schema and tests before editing `projector/service.py`.

**Your job:** consume only a visibility-safe prefix and commit the projection and checkpoint atomically.
